VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: Stop
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description:
One target freezes where they stand for 2 seconds. The stronger the target is next to the speaker, the shorter it lasts (under half a second to 4 seconds). Strains the throat a little.

Every command strains the speaker's throat, more against stronger targets; at full strain they lose their voice for a day. Yuta Okkotsu takes no strain.

The listener has to hear it: deaf listeners are immune, and poor hearing weakens it. Stronger and more psychically sensitive listeners cost more psyfocus and neural heat; one the speaker can't pay for can't be commanded. An ordinary person costs the psyfocus shown and 3 neural heat.

Needs a voice: no command while Talking is under 30%.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: Run Away
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description:
Every enemy within 10 cells of the speaker drops what they are doing and flees for about 4 seconds (under a second to 8 seconds, shorter for stronger enemies).

Every command strains the speaker's throat, more against stronger targets; at full strain they lose their voice for a day. Yuta Okkotsu takes no strain.

The listener has to hear it: deaf listeners are immune, and poor hearing weakens it. Stronger and more psychically sensitive listeners cost more psyfocus and neural heat; one the speaker can't pay for can't be commanded. An ordinary person costs the psyfocus shown and 5 neural heat.

Needs a voice: no command while Talking is under 30%.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: Don't Move
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description:
Every enemy in a circle freezes for about 4 seconds; stronger enemies break free sooner (under a second to 8 seconds).

Every command strains the speaker's throat, more against stronger targets; at full strain they lose their voice for a day. Yuta Okkotsu takes no strain.

The listener has to hear it: deaf listeners are immune, and poor hearing weakens it. Stronger and more psychically sensitive listeners cost more psyfocus and neural heat; one the speaker can't pay for can't be commanded. An ordinary person costs the psyfocus shown and 8 neural heat.

Needs a voice: no command while Talking is under 30%.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: Blast Away
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description:
Every enemy within 5 cells of the speaker is thrown away from them and takes blunt damage: 6 cells and 10 damage against an equal, more against weaker enemies, less against stronger ones.

Every command strains the speaker's throat, more against stronger targets; at full strain they lose their voice for a day. Yuta Okkotsu takes no strain.

The listener has to hear it: deaf listeners are immune, and poor hearing weakens it. Stronger and more psychically sensitive listeners cost more psyfocus and neural heat; one the speaker can't pay for can't be commanded. An ordinary person costs the psyfocus shown and 8 neural heat.

Needs a voice: no command while Talking is under 30%.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: Sleep
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description:
One target falls unconscious for about 3 hours (36 minutes to 6 hours, shorter for stronger targets), or until they're hurt.

Every command strains the speaker's throat, more against stronger targets; at full strain they lose their voice for a day. Yuta Okkotsu takes no strain.

The listener has to hear it: deaf listeners are immune, and poor hearing weakens it. Stronger and more psychically sensitive listeners cost more psyfocus and neural heat; one the speaker can't pay for can't be commanded. An ordinary person costs the psyfocus shown and 10 neural heat.

Needs a voice: no command while Talking is under 30%.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: Get Crushed
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description:
One target is crushed: 30 blunt damage against an equal, more against weaker targets, less against stronger ones.

Every command strains the speaker's throat, more against stronger targets; at full strain they lose their voice for a day. Yuta Okkotsu takes no strain.

The listener has to hear it: deaf listeners are immune, and poor hearing weakens it. Stronger and more psychically sensitive listeners cost more psyfocus and neural heat; one the speaker can't pay for can't be commanded. An ordinary person costs the psyfocus shown and 12 neural heat.

Needs a voice: no command while Talking is under 30%.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: Explode
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description:
One target explodes: 45 damage against an equal, less against stronger targets. A much weaker target is destroyed outright. Strains the throat badly.

Every command strains the speaker's throat, more against stronger targets; at full strain they lose their voice for a day. Yuta Okkotsu takes no strain.

The listener has to hear it: deaf listeners are immune, and poor hearing weakens it. Stronger and more psychically sensitive listeners cost more psyfocus and neural heat; one the speaker can't pay for can't be commanded. An ordinary person costs the psyfocus shown and 18 neural heat.

Needs a voice: no command while Talking is under 30%.

VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.label: Die
VEF.Abilities.AbilityDef.description:
Every enemy within 15 cells hears it: Anomaly entities and mutants weaker than the speaker die on the spot; anyone else takes 40 cursed energy damage, less if they are stronger. Yuta needs Rika fully manifested to give it.

The listener has to hear it: deaf listeners are immune, and poor hearing weakens it. Stronger and more psychically sensitive listeners cost more psyfocus and neural heat; one the speaker can't pay for can't be commanded. An ordinary person costs the psyfocus shown and 25 neural heat.

Needs a voice: no command while Talking is under 30%.

HediffDef.label: throat strain
HediffDef.description: Strain from giving Cursed Speech commands. The stronger the listener, the worse it is. At full strain the voice goes for a while.

HediffDef.label: voice lost
HediffDef.description: The throat is too damaged from Cursed Speech to speak, let alone give a command. It comes back in a day.

HediffDef.label: commanded to sleep
HediffDef.description: Ordered to sleep by Cursed Speech, and asleep until the command wears off or something hurts them.

BackstoryDef.title: jujutsu student
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was trained in jujutsu as a student. [PAWN_pronoun] speaks only in rice ball fillings, so no stray word becomes a command.
